text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So summer camp is finally over, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I did everything I could.
I believe I've grown mentally as well."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she'll be able to show a fulfilling performance in the race.However...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...The thought of saying goodbye to fresh seafood
makes my stomach feel just a little bit... lonely."

—I should buy a souvenir somewhere.
With that thought in mind,
my first summer training camp came to an end...
